posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Final: Guardians 9, White Sox 5 There will be a Game 5 on Saturday in Cleveland for all the marbles, and a date in the ALCS with the Rays.
posts.jp: 最終スコア：ガーディアンズ9、ホワイトソックス5。土曜日にクリーブランドで第5戦が行われ、勝者はレイズとのリーグ優勝決定シリーズ進出が決まる。

posts.text: Bryan Baker earns the save to eliminate the Yankees and send his team to the ALCS

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: There goes that man again. An RBI infield single by José Ramírez pushes it to a 6-4 Guardians lead.

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: The Brewers talk a lot about being a team in every sense of the word, and that extends to the coaches and staff. After keeping the Padres at bay last night, Robert Gasser shouted out someone you don’t often hear about. www.mlb.com/news/robert-...
posts.jp: ブルワーズはあらゆる意味でチームだと語ることが多いが、それはコーチとスタッフにも当てはまる。昨夜パドレスを抑えたロバート・ガッサーが、普段は注目されない人物に感謝を述べた。
